# Kuntasi: a Harappan emporium on west coast

Dhavalikar, MK et al

The evidence from the exavation amply demonstrates that Kuntasi was a sort of industrial establishment and further it shows that the different Harappan sites in Kutch and Saurashtra were expected to perform specialised functions. We now have some evidence which throws light on the causes of the downfall of the Indus Civilization.
